notes: Single source of truth for demo-target PM (arcsec/yr), catalog epoch, and historical markers.
Gaia DR3 positions/PMs are referred to epoch J2016.0 (gaia_source.ref_epoch) — ESA Gaia DR3 documentation.
CatWISE2020 catalog coordinates are referred to MJD 57170 (2015 May 28 ≈ decimal year 2015.405) — CatWISE2020 README / Marocco et al. 2021.
WISE 0855 challenge coordinates (08h55m10.831s, −07d14m42.53s) match the WISE designation epoch (~2010); PM from Luhman 2014 Table 1.
Do not invent catalog positions. missing_markers explain absences honestly.
